item_slumber_pipe.name: slumber pipe
item_slumber_pipe.description: A reed pipe whose one tune is a lullaby older than the kingdom. Stone, they say, sleeps to it.

item_moon_harp.name: moon harp
item_moon_harp.description: A harp strung with silver wire. A tune on it draws one of the creatures of the dark to the player.

item_brass_key.name: brass key
item_brass_key.description: A short brass key with a notched bow. It opens one door, and then it has done its work.

item_brawlers_band.name: brawler's band
item_brawlers_band.description: A plain iron ring. Whatever luck it carried is gone.

item_sunstones.name: the sunstones
item_sunstones.description: Three small stones the colour of a low afternoon sun. They are warm whatever the weather.

item_cloudcallers_staff.name: the cloudcaller's staff
item_cloudcallers_staff.description: A staff of grey wood that smells of rain before it is lifted. One of the three things Ostrun left.

item_ostruns_signet.name: Ostrun's signet
item_ostruns_signet.description: A heavy ring stamped with a sun and a sword. It belonged to Ostrun the Lightbearer.

item_prism_tear.name: the prism tear
item_prism_tear.description: A drop of glass that holds a rainbow caught mid-turn. Poured on water, it will make a way.

item_elowens_locket.name: Elowen's locket
item_elowens_locket.description: A small gold locket the princess gave you. Open it and a thread of light points home, and a small voice tells you how far you have come.

tell_distance.message: The locket warms in your hand. Telgard is {steps} steps behind you.

item_purse_small.name: purse of coins
item_purse_small.description: A leather purse, heavy with coin.
